---
title: "CoDa Stereo registered at INPI"
description: "Our compositional data app for stereology is now registered software."
date: "2026-05-19"
categories: [software]
---

**CoDa Stereo**, the lab's Shiny app for compositional data analysis of
stereological and histomorphometric data, was granted software registration
by the Brazilian National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI,
**BR512026003293-8**) on 19 May 2026.

The app stays free and open source under the MIT licence.
[Try it or read more](../../software.qmd#coda-stereo).
